formulas.ascii: Planar location on the selected positive-length segment: t=clamp((m-M[s])/(M[s+1]-M[s]),0,1); p=(1-t)*a+t*b+h*(-v.y,v.x). m is the scaled/offset event measure (then multiplied by line length in fraction mode) clamped to the line. v is the unit tangent. Zero spans use t=0; single vertices use v=0; invalid lines give NaN. Spherical mode instead slerps and applies the lateral offset by geodesic destination.
